game.name: Amazing Spider-Man, The (Russia)
game.desc: The Amazing Spider-Man is an action game for Xbox 360. It is the sequel to the 2012 film of the same name. Dr. Connors is no longer a threat, but Oscorp has continued its genetic work. Mutants have escaped and are spreading an infection in the city. You have to stop the epidemic and deal with Oscorp's robots who have also targeted you.
